items.title: NEC Completes Acquisition of CSG Systems; Netcracker to Lead Combined Business
items.summary: Customers Will Benefit From an Enhanced Portfolio Supporting Innovative Business Models, AI-Driven Operations and Superior Digital Experiences NEC Corporation , with its wholly owned subsidiary Netcracker Technology , announced today the completion of its acquisition of CSG Systems International, Inc., a U.S.-based provider of software solutions for telecommunications, broadband and digital service providers. The transaction brings together two highly complementary organizations, resulting in a stronger global software business with expanded capabilities across customer engagement, monetization, operations, AI-driven automation and cloud-native platforms. Following the closing, Netcracker will assume responsibility for the operations and integration of CSG, while NEC will support the combined organization through governance, strategic direction and global resources. items.title: CSG Systems International Announces Its 13th Consecutive Year of Increased Dividend Payout
items.summary: Board of Directors approves a 6% increase in its quarterly dividend; company approves Q1 2026 dividend CSG® (NASDAQ: CSGS) today announced that its Board of Directors approved a 6% increase in the Company’s quarterly cash dividend payment. The new quarterly payment amount has been increased to $0.34 per share of common stock to be paid on April 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 18, 2026.
